<script type="module">
import {Runtime, Inspector} from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/runtime@5/dist/runtime.js";
import define from "https://api.observablehq.com/d/2857aebc34edef3f.js?v=4";

  if (name === "your_system") return new Inspector(document.querySelector("#observablehq-your_system-8d0b54a9"));
});
</script>
